description.narrative: Improved delivery of sanitation services by PPUC.

By 2024
Sewer overflows to the land and sea reported to EQPB reduced by 50% (baseline: 2013 average to be established during early implementation). Achievement: 8 Progress/Status: The number of sewer overflows decreased by more than 67% from 25 in 2018 to 8 in 2023 Data Source: EQPB reported data

Treatment system outflow from the discharged pipe in Koror and Airai consistently meets EQPB standards. Achievement: Y Progress/Status: New sewage treatment plant was commissioned in October 2021 and is meeting performance targets. Data Source: EQPB monitoring data Base year: 2013 Baseline value: N
